title: I popped into the mall before it was “ready” for me
content: I was having a horrible visceral nightmare. Rather than willing myself awake for some reason I willed myself to the mall. I’ve never done this before. I popped into a completely empty mall, no stores, no people. It looked like it had not been rendered, like I was “too early” or at least that was the overwhelming feeling. It felt really eerie. Another strange detail is that I was a man in old timey clothes and a top hat lol. I looked around and the familiar places popped up one by one and within moments it was brimming with people. It was brighter and much busier than usual. Has anyone else had a similar experience?
